newsitem.title: UK: BP, Shell higher ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: BP, Shell higher ahead of results.

text.p: Shares in British Petroleum Plc and Shell International Ltd were both up in active trading on Tuesday with investors expecting the companies to post good results next week, traders said.
BP was up 13p at 754 with volume at 2.73 million shares by 1115 GMT while Shell was 6-1/2p higher at 10.70 stg with volume at 964,132.
Traders said there was talk of a possible upgrade in Shell's dividend, due out with Q4 results on Thursday, February 13. BP is due to post Q4 figures on Tuesday, November 11.
"People are expecting them (the results) to be good," one trader said. "There are some decent buyers out there, especially from the States (U.S.)."
Traders said there was also strong buying of both stocks in the U.S. on Monday.
